newsitem.title: USA: Young & Rubicam launches Star Alliance campaign.
newsitem.headline: Young & Rubicam launches Star Alliance campaign.

text.p: Young & Rubicam said it launched a new advertising campaign to support the creation of the Star Alliance, a global airline partnership.

The campaign, backed by a $25 million marketing budget, was produced by Y&R New York. Advertisements will appear in leading business publications across Asia, Europe and North America, starting in mid-May, Young & Rubicam said.

The Star Alliance -- which includes airlines such as UAL Corp's United, Deutsche Lufthansa AG, Air Canada, Scandinavian Airlines System and Thai Airways International Ltd -- was formally launched on Wednesday.

Under the partnership, the carriers will use a common brand in marketing and advertising and will coordinate routes and offer code-sharing, when possible. The alliance is a bid to cut costs and offer simpler, "hassle-free" global travel for passengers and cargo.

"The Star Alliance delivers unprecedented global access and a seamless travel experience to our customers. We wanted a launch campaign that would make a splash, convey these key messages and do both against a very aggressive timetable," said David Coltman, senior vice president of marketing of UAL Corp's United Airlines.

Integrated marketing for the alliance will be handled by a collaboration of Y&R New York, other Y&R Advertising agencies in each region and Y&R sister companies Wunderman Cato Johnson and Cohn & Wolfe, as well as Cambridge Research in Chicago and Pentagram Design in London.
